project_type: Next.js 14 App Router SaaS application with TypeScript
test_framework: TypeScript compilation check (tsc --noEmit), ESLint, Next.js build
verification_instructions: 1. Run npm install, 2. Run npx tsc --noEmit to check types, 3. Run npm run build to verify production build succeeds, 4. Run npm run dev to verify dev server starts
setup_instructions: 1. Remove all existing files except .git, 2. Create Next.js 14 app with TypeScript and Tailwind CSS, 3. Install all dependencies
environment_constraints: Node.js v22.22.3, npm v11.4.2, pnpm v10.28.1 available. No database server available for runtime testing - Prisma schema validation only. No Docker daemon assumed available.
contribution_requirements: Fresh greenfield project - no existing contribution guidelines to follow
key_patterns: Next.js 14 App Router patterns: app/ directory, layout.tsx, page.tsx, route.ts for API routes, server components by default, 'use client' directive for client components. Prisma for ORM. NextAuth.js v4 for auth. Tailwind CSS for styling.
directory_structure: app/ - Next.js App Router pages and API routes, components/ - Reusable React components, lib/ - Utility functions and shared code, prisma/ - Database schema and migrations, public/ - Static assets, types/ - TypeScript type definitions
